label: CRUD Screen
description: A complete list-edit screen over one cloud collection: Query Records list with full-text search and Prev/Next pagination, a side panel that creates (Create Record) or edits (Update Record, form pre-filled via a Record node) the selected row, and per-row delete with an inline Yes/No confirm (Delete Record). Hand-built loading and empty states. The collection is one input: set Class on the CRUD Screen instance.
